capabilities: Synchronize vault files to a Knox portal project as backup storage
Share documents between users via Knox's sharing feature
Run sync at regular intervals or after idle time following edits
Refresh Knox documents monthly to prevent deletion
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns to back up first, that large files may fail to sync due to unclear capacity policies, and that conflicts use Last Write Wins (older edits are overwritten). Also available in Korean.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync or share vault files through the Knox portal as external storage.
summary: Syncs vault files and documents to a Knox portal project for cross-device backup and sharing between users.
